title: Anthrobots may be made from other ciliated human cells such as oviduct or ependyma

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Anthrobots may be made from other ciliated human cells such as oviduct or ependyma

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Anthrobots may be generable from other ciliated human cells, such as oviductal epithelium or brain ependymal cells, and non-ciliated cell types could be used for bots that need no autonomous motility.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Gumuskaya G 2024, Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells › Conclusion

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: Anthrobots may be able to be generated from other ciliated cells in the human body (e.g., oviductal epithelia or brain ependymal cells), and other cell types can be used for bots when autonomous motility is not needed

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Gumuskaya G, Srivastava P, Cooper BG, Lesser H, Semegran B, Garnier S, Levin M, “Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells”, Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany) (2024), doi:10.1002/advs.202303575; section “Conclusion”. Scope: Ciliated and non-ciliated adult human cell types

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2024-anthrobots-28: needs-new-data, resolvability 0.50

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The prediction is experimentally clear for ciliated source cells. Current public data cover airway cells only, so testing the asserted extension requires new cultures and observations.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Apply the Anthrobot culture workflow to clonally seeded oviductal, ependymal, and selected non-ciliated human cells and measure self-construction, viability, motility, and function.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The named alternative cell types were not tested.

Non-motile function is left unspecified.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
data existence: 0.18
data adequacy: 0.1
discriminating power: 0.87
operationalizability: 0.9
analysis feasibility: 0.52

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Formation and motility under the stated protocol are measurable for each named cell type. Public atlases show that oviduct and ependymal cells exist and express cilia genes; they do not contain the culture experiment. The prediction remains a new-experiment claim.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Run the Anthrobot matrix-to-liquid protocol on adult human oviductal epithelium and on ependymal cells, and score external cilia and motility, and run it on a non-ciliated epithelial type scoring multicellular assembly without motility. Motile ciliated spheroids from the first two sources, and immotile spheroids from the third, would support the prediction; failure to form under the same protocol would refute it for those types.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Cilia-gene expression does not show that those cells will reverse polarity and swim.

No public oviduct or ependymal run of the Anthrobot protocol exists.

Non-ciliated bots are an open-ended class rather than one tested type.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
discriminating power: 0.4
data existence: 0.18
analysis feasibility: 0.18
data adequacy: 0.12
operationalizability: 0.74
